action_items: (nit) RelatedEditor chip: guard the with `r.image && ...` to avoid the 'empty string passed to src attribute' console warning when a related product has no image.

(nit, dev-only) Avoid rendering a {c.name} expression directly as the only child of <option> in product-filter-category and pf-category — Visual-Edit-Mode wraps it in an x-ve-dynamic <span>, triggering a hydration warning. Can be sidestepped by concatenating into a template literal, e.g. `{`${c.name}（${c.product_count}）`}`.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py `admin_list_products` pagination truncates `.to_list(size)` AFTER `.skip()` — correct — but no `.limit(size)` is set so motor will fetch all remaining documents from the server; add `.limit(size)` before `.to_list(size)` for perf (2498-row collection is small today, matters at scale).

server.py `_prep_product` always rewrites `account_field_label` to `delivery_fields[0].name` whenever delivery_fields is non-empty. If an admin intentionally wants a different label from the first field name (e.g. localized shorter label), it will be silently overwritten. Consider only setting when `account_field_label` is empty/default '充值帳號'.

server.py admin create/update normalises spec ids starting with 'new-' to new_id(), but a POSTed empty spec id is also replaced; however the UI's SpecsEditor assigns `id: `new-${Date.now()}`` for brand-new rows (good), while PUT allows preserving existing ids. OK — just confirm the UI never collapses two client ids to the same string before PUT.

server.py `admin_patch_product` whitelists 4 keys but returns the updated doc with `content_html` excluded only on PATCH; on the full PUT it returns the doc including content_html (a potentially large field). Consider a lean projection on PUT responses to match PATCH.

CategoriesAdmin.jsx uses window.confirm for delete and relies on native alert UX inside the admin dark panel — inconsistent with the shadcn AlertDialog style used elsewhere. Low priority but visually jarring.

ProductsAdmin pagination state does not persist across tab switches (going to Categories and back resets page=1). If product edit navigates away via SPA and returns, the admin loses their page position. Consider lifting {q,cat,status,page} into a URL query param.
